name: NICKEL PRATT
note: PRATT ON PROSPERITY (doc 57 D2: 'The first time Thad comes to Prosperity in Act II, Pratt is on it, pulling up the stake: PRA_D2 plays as he arrives'; doc 04 PRA_D2: 'with a stake and a mallet, mid-jump, unhurried about it'). Beside the claim marker with his mallet and a new stake of his own. Once Thad has had it out with him (PRA_D2 option 1) he goes back next door at a walk, mallet in hand (errata 97 D).
walkToNote: Between the claim marker and Pratt, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Pratt.

sprite.frameNote: 0 mallet rest · 1 breath · 2 mallet up · 3 mallet down on the new stake. Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds he drives the stake (errata 77).
sprite.statureNote: The bigger man: room-25's master drew him 1.05 of Thad; 1.03 keeps him inside the 5% a standing man is held to (tests/scale.test.ts).

exit.note: Doc 57 D2 sends him back to his own claim; Pratt's claim is next door, past the creek at the right (errata 97 C).
